tools.name: memory.save
tools.desc: Save or update a durable fact.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.desc: Search deep memory by tag. this will NOT find id's or info on notes or other information about features. memory is strictly facts you learned about the world.

tools.name: room.add_note
tools.desc: Add a note/sticky to the room. Text is what is shown on the screen so make sure its what you want user to see. X and Y are coordinates on your room screen. Colors string should be in hexcode.

tools.name: room.delete_note
tools.desc: Delete a note/sticky by id. You MUST find a notes id with room.list_notes tool call first

tools.name: room.list_notes
tools.desc: List notes/stickies currently in the room. Used to get the information about all the notes; including id, text, and location.

tools.name: discord.send
tools.desc: Send a message to Discord. Use this to initiate a conversation or reply to a specific channel/person.

params.target_id: (Optional) The Channel ID or User ID to message. Defaults to last active.

tools.name: social.lookup_user
tools.desc: Search for a user's profile by name or nickname to get their ID for messaging.

params.name: The name or nickname to search for (e.g. 'Desmond', 'ShadowRunner').
